title: Stuffed Pasta Shells
subtitle: with a mushroom and tofu filling, baked in tomato sauce
description: Large pasta shells filled with mushrooms, tofu and soy cheese, baked in a tomato sauce and topped with a vegan parmesan of nutritional yeast and breadcrumbs.

steps.text: Check how many shells fit in your baking dish and cook that many for about 90 percent of the time on the packet. Drain.
Make the filling: heat oil in a pan and fry the onion and garlic until lightly golden.
Add the mushrooms and fry, stirring, until all the liquid evaporates. Add the tofu and soy cheese, season and fry together for another 4-5 minutes. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Make the sauce: fry the onion in a little oil. Add the garlic and keep frying.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for a few minutes. Transfer the sauce to the baking dish.
Assemble: fill the shells with the filling, arrange them in the sauce and bake for 15-20 minutes.
Make the vegan parmesan by mixing the nutritional yeast and breadcrumbs. Remove the dish from the oven, sprinkle over the vegan parmesan and thyme leaves, and serve.
